name: Stipple Volume Rendering
definition: An interactive direct volume illustration system that simulates traditional stipple drawing by generating point lists based on volume characteristics (gradient magnitude/direction) and applying feature enhancements (silhouette curves, varying point sizes, resolution adjustments) to convey tone, texture, and shape.
summary: Stipple Volume Rendering is an object-space, point-based technique that replaces rasterization with stippled points to create an illustrative, sketch-like appearance for volumetric data.
